prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Water, of the Hydrogen Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table, a dress form and rolls of fabric
Time of day: midday — bright even light; a bright square of sunlight from the window on the floor.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: a black cat costume — a glossy black strapless bodysuit, sheer black tights, a cat-ear headband, a curling tail and a bell choker; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 60-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 40-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — one strap — or one side of the neckline — has slipped down off her shoulder, baring that whole shoulder and the top of her arm; she leaves it as it is, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated, leaning slightly forward toward the table, forearms near its edge.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on the table, her elbow on the table.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with her own left hand she holds a clear glass of water catching the light at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
